읽다.x: I read the newspaper every morning.
읽다.t: Pronounced [익따], but 읽어요 is [일거요] — the ㄹ comes back before a vowel.

쉽다.e: ㅂ becomes 우: 쉬워요. Opposite: 어렵다.

공짜.x: The shop gave me this coffee for free.
공짜.e: 'Empty' plus the suffix -짜: something you get for nothing.
공짜.t: Casual; use 공짜로 for "for free." In formal contexts and on signs, use 무료.

굽다.forms: 구워요 · 구웠어요 · 구울 거예요 · 구우세요 (ㅂ irregular)
굽다.m: to grill, to roast, to bake
굽다.x: In the evening, we grilled meat in the yard and ate it.
굽다.e: One verb covers grilling meat, baking bread and roasting sweet potatoes: 군고구마.
굽다.t: Homonym warning: 굽다 'to be bent' is regular — 굽어요, not 구워요.

명소.x: Namsan Tower is one of Seoul's best-known tourist attractions.

즉.forms: A, 즉 B (A, that is, B)
즉.m: that is, namely, in other words
즉.ex: 제 동생의 딸, 즉 제 조카가 오늘 왔어요.
즉.x: My younger sibling's daughter, that is, my niece, came today.

통제.ex: 축제 기간에는 이 도로의 차량 통제가 있어요.
통제.x: During the festival, traffic on this road is restricted.

동의.x: I completely agree with your opinion too.
동의.t: Pattern: N에 동의하다 'agree with N'; 동의서 is a consent form.

상대.ex: 대화할 때는 상대의 눈을 보고 말하세요.
상대.x: When you talk with someone, look them in the eye.
상대.e: Literally 'mutually facing': the one across from you.

피시방.x: I played games all night at a PC bang with my friend.
피시방.t: Often written PC방. Most charge by the hour and deliver snacks like ramyeon to your seat.

웹소설.x: I read web novels on my phone on the way to and from work.
웹소설.t: Pronounced [웹쏘설]: ㅅ becomes tense after ㅂ. Web novels come out in short episodes on apps, usually with the first ones free; hits are often adapted into webtoons and dramas.

승인.ex: 이 일은 부장님의 승인을 받아야 해요.
승인.x: This needs the department head's approval.

정신과.ex: 요즘은 정신과 상담을 받는 사람이 많아졌어요.
정신과.x: These days more people get counseling at psychiatric clinics.
정신과.e: Literally 'mind department'. -과 = medical department: 내과, 안과, 치과.
정신과.t: Pronounced [정신꽈]; many clinics now use the official name 정신건강의학과.

정월 대보름.m: Daeboreum (first full moon of the lunar year)
정월 대보름.x: On Daeboreum, people eat five-grain rice and seasoned greens.
정월 대보름.e: 정월 = first lunar month; 대보름 = 'great full moon', on the 15th day.
정월 대보름.t: People crack nuts like peanuts and walnuts (부럼) that morning, a custom said to keep skin healthy all year.

장구.ex: 장구 소리에 맞춰서 다 같이 춤을 췄어요.
장구.x: We all danced together to the sound of the janggu.
장구.e: From 장고 (杖鼓 'stick drum'), the older name still used by musicians.
장구.t: Played with a thin stick on one head and a mallet or bare hand on the other; play it is 장구를 치다.

자취방.m: room/flat where you live on your own
자취방.ex: 제 자취방은 좁지만 학교에서 가까워서 좋아요.
자취방.x: My place is small, but it's close to school, so I like it.
자취방.e: 자취 'living on your own' (literally 'cooking for yourself') + 방 'room'.
자취방.t: Pronounced [자취빵]. Usually a small 원룸 rented with 월세; 자취방 구하기 'finding a place of your own' is a familiar task for university students.

직관.ex: 때로는 논리보다 직관을 믿는 게 나아요.
직관.x: Sometimes it's better to trust your intuition than logic.
직관.e: Literally 'direct seeing' — knowing without reasoning step by step.

치솟다.m: to shoot up, to soar, to rise sharply
치솟다.x: Prices have shot up, so living costs are high.
치솟다.e: 치- is an intensifying prefix 'upward, hard' plus 솟다 'to rise, gush up'.
치솟다.t: Also literal: 불길이 치솟다 = flames shoot up.

궁리하다.m: to think hard about, to mull over, to figure out
궁리하다.ex: 어떻게 하면 돈을 아낄 수 있을지 궁리하고 있어요.
궁리하다.x: I'm trying to figure out how I can save money.
궁리하다.e: Literally 'get to the bottom of the reason' — thinking a problem through.
궁리하다.t: Pronounced [궁니하다] — ㄹ turns into ㄴ after ㅇ.

박테리아.ex: 손을 자주 씻으면 박테리아를 줄일 수 있어요.
박테리아.x: Washing your hands often can reduce bacteria.

속임수.ex: 그 광고는 소비자를 속이는 속임수에 불과해요.
속임수.x: That ad is nothing more than a trick to deceive consumers.

맹세.ex: 두 사람은 평생 서로 사랑하겠다고 맹세를 했어요.
맹세.x: The two vowed to love each other for the rest of their lives.
맹세.e: Originally read 맹서; the second syllable shifted to 세 in everyday speech.
맹세.t: 맹세코 means 'I swear' and is used for emphasis: 맹세코 저는 몰랐어요.

피가 거꾸로 솟다.forms: 피가 거꾸로 솟았어요 · 피가 거꾸로 솟는 것 같아요
피가 거꾸로 솟다.m: to be furious, one's blood boils (lit. the blood surges backward)
피가 거꾸로 솟다.ex: 그 사람이 거짓말하는 걸 듣고 피가 거꾸로 솟았어요.
피가 거꾸로 솟다.x: When I heard him lie, my blood boiled.
피가 거꾸로 솟다.e: Anger seems to push the blood the wrong way (거꾸로 'upside down, backward'), rushing up to the head.
피가 거꾸로 솟다.t: A strong expression of rage at an insult or injustice. 솟는 is pronounced [손는]. Casual alternative: 열받다.

벌금형.ex: 그는 음주 운전으로 500만 원의 벌금형을 선고받았습니다.
벌금형.x: He was sentenced to a fine of 5 million won for drunk driving.
벌금형.e: -형 = type of sentence: 벌금형, 징역형, 사형.
벌금형.t: 과태료 is an administrative penalty (like a parking fine), while 벌금형 is a criminal sentence.

역진세.ex: 부가가치세는 저소득층에게 부담이 큰 역진세라는 비판을 받습니다.
역진세.x: VAT is criticized as a regressive tax that weighs heavily on low-income people.
역진세.e: Literally 'reverse-progression tax': the burden falls harder on lower incomes.

억제.ex: 이 약은 염증을 억제하는 효과가 있어요.
억제.x: This medicine has the effect of suppressing inflammation.
억제.t: Used in medicine and economics too: 물가 억제 (curbing prices), 식욕 억제제 (appetite suppressant).

응결.x: Clouds form in the sky through the condensation of water vapor.
응결.t: 응결 is gas to liquid (condensation); 응고 is liquid to solid — don't mix them up.

수소이온농도.x: The higher the hydrogen ion concentration, the stronger the acidity.
수소이온농도.t: In everyday Korean people usually just say 피에이치 (pH) instead.

유전자변형.x: Genetically modified foods must be labeled.

협연.m: performing with (as a soloist with an orchestra), joint performance
협연.ex: 그 피아니스트는 서울시향과 협연을 하게 되었어요.
협연.x: That pianist will be performing with the Seoul Philharmonic.

궁녀.ex: 궁녀들은 궁궐 안에서 왕실의 생활을 도왔어요.
궁녀.x: Court ladies assisted the royal family's daily life inside the palace.

망연자실.m: being stunned and at a loss, dazed with shock
망연자실.x: The family was stunned by the sudden news of the accident.
망연자실.e: Literally 'blankly losing oneself' — too shocked to think.
망연자실.t: Usually 망연자실하다 or 망연자실한 표정, describing a reaction to sudden loss or disaster.

풍미하다.m: to dominate, to sweep (an era), to be all the rage
풍미하다.x: That singer dominated the pop music scene of the 1990s.
풍미하다.e: Literally 'grass bending before the wind' — everything yielding to one trend.
풍미하다.t: Homonym warning: 풍미 風味 is 'flavor', as in 풍미가 좋다.

오붓하다.x: We spent some cozy time together as a family over the weekend.
오붓하다.t: Pronounced [오부타다]; it praises a small, close group, not a place.

격세지감.m: the feeling that times have changed completely
격세지감.ex: 스마트폰으로 모든 일을 하는 걸 보면 격세지감을 느껴요.
격세지감.x: Seeing everything done by smartphone, I feel how much times have changed.
격세지감.e: Literally 'feeling of being a generation apart'.
격세지감.t: Almost always used with 느끼다: 격세지감을 느끼다.

초록동색.m: birds of a feather, like sticks with like
초록동색.x: Birds of a feather — the two of them became friends right away.
초록동색.e: Literally 'grass and green are the same color.'
초록동색.t: Often quoted as the saying 초록은 동색.
rel: people side with their own kind
